result: Look bro, I'm really annoyed. Actually I have an urgent presentation to do on this project. The branch developed is a more advanced but it's not ready. But actually I need a version that is very specific because at some point there was for a long time a Kimike 2.5 on Grok but it was deprecated and removed. So at some point I started to move to OSS 120b, but the design and UI is bad. But then actually we started at some point with a small commit, which is the one that I want you to discover, is when we replace OSS 120b with either OpenRouter and Kimi, or either Olamacloud and Kimi. This is this commit that we are targeting that is most likely to be the one, the most stable that we want. So can you tell me which commit it is?
